title: Fan COLLAPSES at Trump Rally - Doctor Oz RUSHES TO HELP
text: Fan COLLAPSES at Trump Rally – Doctor Oz RUSHES TO HELPDuring a speech by Donald Trump, a person in the audience fainted, prompting first responders and Dr. Oz to attend to the medical emergency. Trump paused his speech, instructing his staff to play Ave Maria while the situation was addressed. After a lengthy break, he returned to the stage and commented: “We’re talking about Gavin Newsom. Doesn’t seem like a very good subject right now. It made that young lady not feel so good.
